name: @steuererklaerung/store
author: Pascal Garber
description: Local data store for steuererklaerung: the unified NDJSON transaction store (with mtime-keyed in-memory memoization) + the SQLite ledger core (schema, periods, entity mapping). The read/query surface the DMS and the future GNOME app build on; sync/normalize/EÜR-seeding stays in the CLI. Pure TypeScript, runs on Node + GJS (node:sqlite/node:fs via gjsify).
